state_queries.scheduled: SELECT count(*) FROM pgboss.job WHERE name = 'long_horizon_bench' AND state = 'created' AND start_after > now()
state_queries.retryable: SELECT count(*) FROM pgboss.job WHERE name = 'long_horizon_bench' AND state = 'retry'
state_queries.dead: SELECT count(*) FROM pgboss.job WHERE name = 'long_horizon_bench' AND state = 'failed'
